query: Inspect this electrical-commutator surface for a visible production defect. Treat only a localized crack, scratch, void, chip, or irregular dark discontinuity as a defect; regular vertical seams, machining texture, illumination gradients, and border shadows are not defects. If a defect is clearly visible, return violation and one tight pixel-space bbox labeled defect. If no defect is visible, return compliant. If image evidence is genuinely insufficient or ambiguous, return uncertain rather than inventing a box.
